incident.finishNoteApp: Note sent to the App of vehicles still on duty (optional)

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.hint: Pick vehicles near the scene: only online vehicles of the responsible unit and its sub-units, closest first. You can skip this and dispatch later.
dispatch.noVehicle: No online vehicles within this radius
dispatch.pickLocationFirst: Set the incident location to find the nearest vehicles
dispatch.recallDesc: The vehicle is released immediately; its App receives the recall with the reason below.

dispatch.notePlaceholder: Note sent with the dispatch order to the App (optional)

activity.description: Replay a vehicle's route (up to 24 hours at a time)
activity.max24h: The time range can be at most 24 hours
activity.noData: No GPS data in this time range

device.description: Tracked vehicles and the officers assigned to them
device.imeiTip: Device identifier, unique within a unit
device.lockedWhileMobilized: This vehicle is on a mission: IMEI, type, status and unit cannot be changed.
device.officerHint: App accounts bound to this vehicle. Each officer is bound to one vehicle only.
device.removeOfficerConfirm: Remove this officer from the vehicle?
device.rotateDesc: The App using the old key must sign in again.

tenant.deleteDesc: Only possible when it has no sub-units, accounts, vehicles or incidents.
tenant.codeTip: Unique across the system, cannot be changed later
tenant.lockTip: Locking a unit also locks every sub-unit and signs out its accounts

user.description: Web accounts (dispatchers, commanders) and App accounts (officers on vehicles)
user.resetPasswordDesc: Every session of this account will be signed out.
user.permissionHint: Locked items come from the role (change the role to change them). Tick extra items to grant them directly — you can only grant permissions you hold.
user.roleHint: The gps_user role is for officers' App accounts.

role.description: Permission bundles per role; an account's permissions = role bundle + direct grants

desc.tenant_admin: Read and write the whole branch; manage accounts, roles, vehicles and incidents.
desc.unit_admin: Read the whole branch, write within own unit, edit own unit info.
desc.gps_user: App account: only sees incidents its vehicle is assigned to.
desc.customer_user: Can enter the admin site; other permissions granted directly.
desc.custom: Empty role — permissions are granted directly.

permission.fromRole: Comes from the role, cannot be removed individually
permission.notGrantable: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot grant it

audit.description: Who did what and when — within your part of the organization tree

settings.deviceTypesHint: Shared by every organization. Only platform admins can edit.
settings.retentionNotSynced: Saved, but not applied to MongoDB yet
